binary64_rounding.explanation: At 1.0, the upward binary64 spacing is 2^-52 and half that spacing is 2^-53. The added 2^-54 is below half an ulp, so 1 + 2^-54 rounds to 1.0; subtracting the lost Dold after cancellation leaves -2^-54.
binary64_rounding.rounding: IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest, ties-to-even under pinned Intel strict FP profile

question_tested: Can (laterResidual64 + deltaPrecision64) + (Dprepared64 - Dold64) leave a signed residual when coupled_before32 equals t_before32, non-diffusion remainder is zero, Dprepared is zero, and the stored prepared endpoint is zero?
